name: The Platinum Card®

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: $195 annual fee for each Additional Platinum Card; Companion Cards may have $0 annual fee — confirm current terms.

apr.notes: See American Express Rates and Fees; product may use Pay Over Time features.

categories.label: Flights booked directly with airlines or through American Express Travel
Prepaid hotels booked on American Express Travel

rewards.redemption_notes: Membership Rewards transfer partners and Pay with Points options vary.

signup_bonus.description: Welcome Membership Rewards points are personalized; Amex product HTML bundles other cards' spend language. Do not treat a single spend figure as authoritative without the live welcome module. Third-party trackers (e.g. credit-card-bonuses-api) often show ~100,000 points after $8,000 in 6 months — discovery clue only.

benefits.title: Global Lounge Collection
benefits.description: Access to Centurion Lounges, Priority Pass (enrollment required), limited Delta Sky Club visits when flying eligible Delta, and other partner lounges — over 1,550 lounges marketed.

benefits.title: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck fee credit
benefits.description: Statement credit every 4 years for Global Entry ($120) or TSA PreCheck (up to $85 through CLEAR; confirm current Amex terms) when application fee is charged to the card.

benefits.title: Uber Cash
benefits.description: Up to $200 Uber Cash annually when Card is added to Uber account ($15 monthly + $20 December bonus); terms apply.

benefits.title: Uber One credit
benefits.description: Up to $120 in statement credits per calendar year for auto-renewing Uber One membership.

benefits.title: Airline Fee Credit
benefits.description: Up to $200 airline fee credit for incidental fees charged by a selected airline; categories and eligibility per Amex terms.

benefits.title: Fine Hotels + Resorts / Hotel Collection perks
benefits.description: Complimentary benefits on eligible prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts and Hotel Collection stays (e.g., property credit, breakfast, upgrade when available).

lounge_access.program: Global Lounge Collection (Centurion + Priority Pass + partners)
lounge_access.notes: Delta Sky Club access is limited (e.g., 10 visits when flying eligible Delta); confirm current enrollment rules.

notes: Credits and lounge entitlements are offer/enrollment-dependent. Cross-checked fee $895 and 5x flight/hotel earn against Amex official page; welcome bonus left null after third-party cross-check showed conflict with polluted $3,000 spend text in page bundle.
